studyQueue.title: The AI Iceberg Index: Sector & Role Exposure Across North America
studyQueue.question: How much of the wage economy is exposed to AI beneath the visible tech surface (MIT / Oak Ridge Project Iceberg: 2.2% visible vs. 11.7% submerged), how do occupational roles break down inside the 12 major NAICS industries, and how does exposure shift across regional economies?
studyQueue.dataset: MIT / ORNL Project Iceberg (151M workers, 923 occupations, 32k skills) + BLS OES / StatCan NAICS sector matrices
studyQueue.notes: First end-to-end Workbench test study: interactive regional map, 12-industry x 6-role matrix, and compiled LaTeX PDF.

studyQueue.title: 2026 Alberta Referendum: All 10 Ballot Questions & Demographic Vote Anatomy
studyQueue.question: Why did Alberta voters pass all 5 non-constitutional immigration/voter-ID questions, reject all 4 constitutional amendments, and vote 74.95% to 25.05% to remain in Canada — and how did age, region, party coalition, and identity attachment divide the vote?
studyQueue.dataset: Elections Alberta Oct 19, 2026 count (>2.07M ballots) + Abacus Data (n=1,021) + Research Co. exit & pre-vote polls (n=811, n=601)
studyQueue.notes: Second Workbench study: compares ballot categories, regional/age/party splits, and voter motives with a compiled LaTeX PDF.

Count the deficit in chalk dust, never count what it cost.

Everybody wants the leverage till you tally the toll.
